$comment: Manual judgments for public PR replays after inspecting diffs + docs at head. Synthetic cases are scored automatically against expectIds.

method.tp: Finding correctly flags a new public surface that docs do not meaningfully document
method.fp: Finding fires but the surface is documented, internal, or not user-facing
method.fn: A new public surface should have been flagged but was not
method.tn: No finding, and none expected (docs updated, no new surface, or out of detector scope)

public.notes: New CLI flags / Action inputs / MCP params were documented in README in the same PR.
sparse-checkout inputs added with README updates.
Adds hand-rolled `--read-only` argv parsing (not commander/argparse/click). Known v1 limitation.
Library internals; no new consumer-facing CLI surface in-repo.
Default-value display change; no new click options detected as new surfaces.
Behavior change around existing --manual; no new argparse long flags.
Warn-vs-fail behavior; no new Action inputs.
Description-only edit to existing package_json_file input.
